description: The lookups a resolver answered, per querying client: data source 5, the sole source of site names. Each provider stores what its resolver reports into its own table (the unbound plugin's plugin_unbound.dns_resolution, ADR 0020 wave 4), reports an interval that rotated out of the resolver's buffer as a collection gap, and never presents what it read as coverage of a window.

cadences.basis: Survey, data source 5, "Sustainable polling frequency": DNS lookups must be correlated with flows that follow within seconds, so the window has to be short. The verified section removes the windowing but not the urgency: the endpoint is a ring buffer of the last 1000 lookups, so a slow poll loses the oldest of them outright.

sizing.basis: The resolver's ring buffer: the endpoint holds the last 1000 lookups and nothing older, whatever is asked. The page is not a setting for this read at all; only the interval keeps the buffer from wrapping between two polls, so a suggestion for this kind carries an interval and no page.
